messages:
Asha Patel: Heads-up  we need the final content pass for the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Focus areas: launch post cadence, webinar landing & signups, inbound lead routing (webhook payload), and microcopy to deflect basic pre-sales questions. Can folks split tasks?
Miguel Torres: I can build the launch calendar and draft social + blog copy. Prefer hero that sells operational guarantees: latency, cost predictability, not a model list.
Samira Chen: Added three hero variants to the draft doc. My favorites: "Predictable inference. One API. Any deployment." and "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost." Need succinct subheads and the three CTAs.
Jules Park: UI tweak: put the three CTAs inline under the hero so clicks map to deployment_interest cleanly. Short CTAs I propose: "Start Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Install Private". I'll update mobile spacing.
Nina O'Connor: SEO/legal note: use terms "inference API" and "LLM inference platform". Avoid "hosting". Add canonical for /deployments and ensure meta description includes "predictable latency" + "SLA" where relevant.
Miguel Torres: Webinar plan (wk2): benchmarks + migration playbook + live Q&A. Landing form must collect name, company, email, estimated monthly tokens, deployment_interest (hosted|dedicated|private). We need routing rules for Sales vs Growth SDR.
Samira Chen: Landing webhook pseudocode to include in dev ticket:
```
// webinar signup routing pseudocode
payload = {"lead_type": "webinar", "email": email, "company": company, "est_tokens": tokens, "deployment_interest": deployment_choice, "utm_source": utm_source, "original_cta": cta}
if payload.est_tokens >= 15000 || payload.deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  route = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
// always include enterprise_interest flag when CTA=="Reserve Dedicated"
```
Miguel Torres: Important: tag leads with deployment_interest derived from which CTA they clicked. If CTA == "Reserve Dedicated" set enterprise_interest=true and trigger the higher-touch email sequence.
Jules Park: Dedicated card microcopy suggestion: "Reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed latency targets. Predictable throughput for production workloads. Contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Reserved capacity, predictable p99 latency."
Nina O'Connor: CRM mapping fields to standardize in the webhook: lead_type (webinar|trial|enterprise), deployment_interest (hosted|dedicated|private), enterprise_interest (true|false), est_tokens (integer), lead_source (social|blog|webinar), original_cta (string). Make sure these exact keys are present so downstream mapping is clean.
Samira Chen: Email nurture flow (short): 1) Instant confirmation: thank you + calendar + quickstart link + benchmarks PDF. 2) 48h follow-up: migration playbook excerpt + CTA to request a dedicated trial. 3) Day-before: reminder with join link. If enterprise_interest=true, attach SSO context and a demo request link.
Asha Patel: Final asks by EOD Thu: 1) lock hero + three short CTAs, 2) paste webhook pseudocode into the dev ticket, 3) draft webinar narrative (benchmarks + migration playbook + live Q&A). Staging copy deploys Fri if PR merged. :rocket:
Miguel Torres: I'll drop the social calendar and hero copy into the doc today.
Samira Chen: Opening PR for the copy and email templates  will tag reviewers.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled Fri 16:00 UTC  will include marketing pages if PR merged by 15:30 UTC.
Asha Patel: Ping if blocked. We'll iterate after we get analytics from the webinar and the post-launch social cadence.
